thread:
sara-oncall: paging: 🔔 Alert - increased 5xx rate (~15%) on /v1/streaming from canary SDK 0.21.0 rollout. Canary hosts show errors starting ~10m after rollout. Low latency but high error.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-184524 - SDK canary streaming errors. Severity: P2.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout sdk-service v0.21.0 -> canary (hosts: canary-1, canary-2, canary-3). CI: ✅

tim-sre: Sara - any obvious network blips? or is this app-level? Can you paste a sample error from logs?
sara-oncall: Logs show a lot of "stream closed with error: PROTOCOL_MISMATCH" and "client handshake: unexpected frame" from canary-instances. No infra host OOMs, CPU fine.

mike-sdk: fyi I bundled a small change in 0.21.0: switched streaming wire format to framed-chunks (added 4-byte length prefix) to align with new server-side streaming implementation. Older server runtime expects newline-delimited chunks. Did we coordinate server roll? :grimacing:

lina-eng: oof. So servers in hosted pool still on runtime 2.3 which expects ndjson streaming. Canary clients are sending framed chunks -> parser rejects -> 400/5xx? Looks like a contract mismatch.

anna-cs: Impact: we currently have three customers on canary traffic (BetaCorp, GreenMetrics, ACME-Edge) using streaming ingest. I've flagged CS tickets and notified their CSMs. BetaCorp seeing retries, some messages dropped. Estimated affected requests ~3k/min at peak.

tim-sre: Mitigation options:
- quick FF kill/disable new streaming format on clients (kill-switch via feature flag)
- rollback client rollout to 0.20.11 on canary hosts
- or fast-update server to accept framed chunks (riskier)

sara-oncall: I can flip the FF now. Is that a runtime toggle on the canary config? lina?
lina-eng: yep - feature flag is `sdk:streaming_v2`. I'll apply kill to canary group. Doing it now.

deploy-bot: Feature flag update: `sdk:streaming_v2=false` applied to canary group at 1845240300. Observability note: flag propagation ~30s.

sara-oncall: After FF flip, error rate dropped to ~2% on canaries within 60s. Rolling metrics look good. :thumbsup:

mike-sdk: Thanks. I'll prepare an emergency patch to revert the framing change and cut 0.21.1 that keeps legacy framing by default and adds opt-in.

tim-sre: Recommend rollback of the canary rollout to avoid accidental wider rollout. Can we stop the automated progressive rollout? deploy-bot?
sara-oncall: Rollout paused (FF controlled). But we should also revert canary pool to previous binary. Who can initiate rollback?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused. Automated progressive rollout halted.

lina-eng: I'll queue a hotfix deploy for server parsing too (accept both ndjson and framed) but that's going to take ~2-3 hours to test. For now, rollback client and ship 0.21.1 asap.

anna-cs: Created customer-facing tickets with temporary mitigation steps (retry guidance + advise to avoid canary clients). Notifying enterprise customers.

mike-sdk: Patch ready locally. Cutting 0.21.1 now. Patch changes:
```
- revert: streaming framing
- add: runtime opt-in header `X-Streaming-Format: framed|ndjson`
```
Will publish binary and ask deploy team to roll canary hosts back to 0.20.11 then redeploy 0.21.1 when validated.

tim-sre: I'll validate canary traffic after rollback and monitor for any regression. Also adding a smoke test for streaming handshake in the canary gating checks.

sara-oncall: Handoff - I'm going offline in 30m. Tim, can you take lead on monitoring and customer comms? I'll leave notes in INC-2026-184524.

tim-sre: Taking handoff. I'll coordinate the rollback and follow up with a brief postmortem. Adding `@oncall-rotation` tag for visibility.

incident-bot: Handoff note: primary incident owner -> tim-sre at 1845241800.

lina-eng: Postmortem TODOs:
- clarify API contract for streaming and publish formal doc (server + SDK expectations)
- add integration test to CI that runs ndjson and framed clients against server parser
- add canary gating test for handshake
- increase rollout safeguards for protocol-changing changes (explicit server runtime bump required)

mike-sdk: Will open PR with docs and opt-in header. Also adding a compatibility test matrix in SDK repo.

anna-cs: Noted customer impact summary sent to growth + ops. No escalations to execs yet. Waiting to see if any revenue-impacting customers file severe tickets.

tim-sre: Current state: FF kill confirmed; canary errors dropped to baseline; rollback of canary client scheduled at 1845242100; monitoring on green. I'll update INC with timeline and owners.

sara-oncall: Thanks all. Please add any follow-up tickets to INC-2026-184524. :white_check_mark:

lina-eng: quick note - teach_deploy runbooks updated to require server runtime compatibility checkbox before any client protocol change.

mike-sdk: ❤️ will sync with SDK SIG to avoid future mismatches.

sara-oncall: closing on-call for now — leaving incident under tim for postmortem. Good catch everyone.
